outputs.question: How do I edit an existing customer?

input.question: how do i edit an existing customer

excerpts.title: Edit a saved customer’s details
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Open Toolbox → Resources → Contacts. Search for the beginning of the customer’s company name, then select the company name to open Customer Inspector. Edit Customer / Company Name, or expand Additional Information (Optional) to edit Contact Name, Phone Number or Email Address. Choose Save Changes. Lead/Admin access is required to edit a saved customer; read-only accounts cannot save changes. Saved changes apply to future selections. Existing Jobs and Proposals keep their captured information.

excerpts.title: Shared Contacts and Customer Inspector
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Saved customer editing requires existing business-write and customer-detail editing permissions. Future selections use updated directory values; existing Jobs/issued Proposals retain their captured values. Customer search and Linked Jobs are available separately with operational-read access. raw.answer: To edit an existing customer, go to Toolbox → Resources → Contacts. Search for the customer's company name, then select it to open Customer Inspector. Edit the Customer/Company Name or expand Additional Information to edit Contact Name, Phone Number, or Email Address. Choose Save Changes. Note: Lead/Admin access is required to edit a customer. Existing Jobs and Proposals will retain their captured information, while future selections will use the updated details.

outputs.question: How do I create a group conversation?

input.question: how do i create a group conversation

excerpts.title: Create a group conversation
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Open Messaging from the app header. Choose New group, enter a group name, select at least one other participant, then choose Create group. Only the creator can rename the group or add/remove participants. Current members share the full history; removed members lose access. Previously signed attachment links may remain usable for up to ten minutes.

excerpts.title: Messaging groups, personal DMs and conversation privacy
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Employees can create creator-managed groups, send messages and attachments, and reply within an authorized conversation. Adding a third person to an existing personal DM is not supported: create a separate group; old DM history stays private and is not copied. A dedicated Share Job control is not verified; do not invent it. Official TenOps system notices retain separate authority. TenBot receives no employee Messaging records. - My Work and Inbox are participant/private domains. Task estimated effort supports workload views; attachments and typing/Realtime authorization preserve private boundaries.

Only the creator can manage the group. Adding a third person to a personal DM is not supported; create a separate group instead.
